name: Dueling Grounds ⚔️
desc:
⚔️ Fast-paced PvP fighting game where you fight with various weapons to become the strongest. Claim your place at the top!

The game is Available on PC, Mobile and Console

PC CONTROLS (You can change them in settings)

M1 / M2 - Light / Heavy Attack
F - Parry / (Hold) Block
Q or Shift - Dodge
M3 or T - Lock to Enemy
Ctrl - Mouse Lock / Unlock
Space - Jump
R - Ultimate

llm.loop: queue into weapon duels -> fight with light/heavy attacks, parry, dodge, ultimates -> win to climb -> unlock new weapons with gems
llm.objectives: become the strongest fighter and reach the top
llm.progression: weapon unlocks (naginata, dual daggers, gauntlets, kusarigama), likely rank/leaderboard
llm.instructions: fast-paced PvP with various weapons; M1/M2 light/heavy, F parry/block, Q dodge, T lock-on, R ultimate
unique: souls-like/fighting-game style dueling with parry timing in a realistic samurai setting, unusual polish for Roblox
update_signals: weapons early access implies ongoing weapon drops

llm.complexity_notes: realistic environments, custom combat animations per weapon, parry/lock-on combat system, cross-platform controls
